finalText:
原文存在若干语法和表达问题：`affect` 应为名词 `effect`，`study` 主谓不一致，`to` 介词不当，`make battery worse` 过于口语化。以下是改写建议：

---

**Polished Version:**

> This paper investigates the effect of temperature on battery performance. The results indicate that elevated temperatures significantly degrade battery performance.

---

**也可更简洁的单一长句版本：**

> This study examines the detrimental effect of elevated temperature on battery performance, demonstrating that high-temperature conditions lead to significant performance degradation.

---

**改写要点说明：**

| 原文问题 | 修改 |
|:---|:---|
| `study` → 主谓不一致 | 改为 `investigates` / `examines`（学术写作常用动词） |
| `affect` 误用为名词 | 改为 `effect`（名词） |
| `to battery performance` | 改为 `on battery performance`（correct collocation） |
| `make battery worse` 口语化 | 改为 `degrade battery performance` / `performance degradation` |
| 缺少研究发现的正式表述 | 加入 `The results indicate / demonstrate that...` |
